metadata.title: Suspicious Inbox Forwarding Rule - Sentinel Scheduled Rule
metadata.description: Detects newly created Exchange inbox rules that auto-forward mail externally or hide/delete security alert mail — a classic Business Email Compromise (BEC) persistence indicator.
Name of the Log Analytics workspace hosting Microsoft Sentinel
List of internal/approved external domains excluded from the forwarding check

properties.displayName: New mailbox rule forwards or hides mail suspiciously
properties.description: Flags New-InboxRule / Set-InboxRule operations in Exchange audit logs that forward mail to an external address, or that mark security-alert mail as read and move it to a rarely-checked folder.
properties.query:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule")
| extend Parameters_ = parse_json(Parameters)
| extend ForwardTo = tostring(Parameters_.ForwardTo), RedirectTo = tostring(Parameters_.RedirectTo), MarkAsRead = tostring(Parameters_.MarkAsRead), MoveToFolder = tostring(Parameters_.MoveToFolder)
| where isnotempty(ForwardTo) or isnotempty(RedirectTo) or (MarkAsRead == "True" and isnotempty(MoveToFolder))
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, ForwardTo, RedirectTo, MarkAsRead, MoveToFolder, ClientIP
